Home.lead: The global learning community for TOPIK learners preparing for TOPIK I and TOPIK II — wherever you live.

About.title: About TOPIK Campus
About.lead: A place to learn, practice and pass TOPIK together — not an official exam body.
About.body1: TOPIK Campus helps international learners prepare for TOPIK I and TOPIK II with practice, feedback and a shared community.
About.body2: We are not the National Institute for International Education, and we do not administer the official test. Course content, scores and AI comments are study aids only.
About.body3: The community is one global room. Switch language in the top right to read the same posts in English, Korean, Vietnamese, Indonesian or Chinese.

Topik.title: TOPIK I and TOPIK II
Topik.lead: Choose the exam that matches your current Korean level. This table is a study overview, not an official specification.
Topik.note: Always confirm dates, fees and formats on the official TOPIK website. TOPIK Campus does not register candidates or issue certificates.

Legal.termsBody: TOPIK Campus is provided for language study. Practice scores, AI comments and community posts are not official TOPIK results. Do not copy official exam papers. You are responsible for the content you publish.
Legal.privacyBody: We aim to collect only what is needed to run accounts, progress and community features. Privacy details will be expanded before sign-in launches. Contact us if you need a data request.
Legal.disclaimerBody: TOPIK Campus is an independent learning platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the official TOPIK administering organization. TOPIK is a trademark of its respective owner. AI feedback is not an official score.
